pairs.target: níng qí bǐ yuē hǎo de shíchén wǎn le yígèduō zhōngtóu .
pairs.english: Ningqi arrived more than an hour after the agreed time.
pairs.hanzi: 宁岐比约好的时辰晚了一个多钟头。

pairs.target: tā zǒujìn kèzhàn shí , bàntiáo kùtuǐ shī dào xī shàng , jiān hòu gēnzhe yígè káng cháng xiāng de niánqīng nánrén .
pairs.english: She entered the inn with a trouser leg wet to the knee, followed by a young man carrying a long case.
pairs.hanzi: 她走进客栈时，半条裤腿湿到膝上，肩后跟着一个扛长箱的年轻男人。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng gāng qǐshēn , tā biàn táishǒu jiào tā bié wèn , chēlún xiànjìn zuóyè de ní wō , gǎnchē de rén fēi shuō rào lìngyìbiān gèng kuài , rào chūqù yòu kànjiàn yìtóu bùkěn rànglù de niú .
pairs.english: As Ruan Heng rose, she raised a hand to stop his questions. A wheel had sunk into last night's mud, the driver had insisted the other way was quicker, and the detour met a cow refusing to move.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡刚起身，她便抬手叫他别问，车轮陷进昨夜的泥窝，赶车的人非说绕另一边更快，绕出去又看见一头不肯让路的牛。

pairs.target: sāngè rén tuīchē tuī dé hànshī , niú cóngtóudàowěi zhàn zhe chī cǎo .
pairs.english: The three pushed until they were sweaty; the cow stood eating grass the whole time.
pairs.hanzi: 三个人推车推得汗湿，牛从头到尾站着吃草。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng bāng nánrén jiē xiāng , duìfāng shuō bú zhòng , zhuǎnshēn shí què xiǎnxiē pèngdào ménliáng , biàn jiāng yìtóu dìgěi tā .
pairs.english: Tavi offered to help with the case. The man said it was not heavy, but nearly hit the lintel while turning and handed him one end.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想帮男人接箱，对方说不重，转身时却险些碰到门梁，便将一头递给他。

pairs.target: níng qí tóu yě bù huí , xiān qù xǐshǒu , liúxià liǎnggè niánqīngrén hùxiāng kàn le yìyǎn , gèzì rěnzhù xiào .
pairs.english: Ningqi went to wash without turning around, leaving the two young men exchanging a glance and suppressing smiles.
pairs.hanzi: 宁岐头也不回，先去洗手，留下两个年轻人互相看了一眼，各自忍住笑。

pairs.target: nánrén jiào ā xún , běndì qǐnglái de jià gōng , qiánrì yǐjīng suíchē qù jiē tā , jiàn guò jiù hú shàngmiàn nà jiān wūzi .
pairs.english: The man was Axun, a locally hired rigger who had gone to meet her with the cart two days earlier and had seen the room above the old arch.
pairs.hanzi: 男人叫阿荀，本地请来的架工，前日已经随车去接她，见过旧弧上面那间屋子。

pairs.target: tā shuō zìjǐ xiǎoshíhòu yě pá guò , hòulái zhīdào ménwài méi lù , biàn bú xiàng tóuyìhuí nàyàng jí zhuóxiǎng jìnqù .
pairs.english: He said he had climbed there as a child too, but after learning there was no road beyond the door, he was less eager than the first time to enter.
pairs.hanzi: 他说自己小时候也爬过，后来知道门外没路，便不像头一回那样急着想进去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn tā yǒu duō xiǎo , tā xiǎng le xiǎng , shēnshǒu bǐ dào zìjǐ yāo biān , níng qí cóng hòutou shuō bùxǔ gěi rén luàn bǐ , nǎ yǒu háizi cháng dào nǐ yāo biān hái méi xuéhuì zǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi asked how young. After thinking, he gestured at his waist; Ningqi said from behind not to give random heights: what child reached his waist before learning to walk?
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问他有多小，他想了想，伸手比到自己腰边，宁岐从后头说不许给人乱比，哪有孩子长到你腰边还没学会走。

pairs.target: tā jiāng tóufa chóngxīn shù hǎo , zuò dào zhuōbiān , yìzhāng zhāng kàn tāmen huà de tú .
pairs.english: She retied her hair, sat at the table, and examined their drawings one by one.
pairs.hanzi: 她将头发重新束好，坐到桌边，一张张看他们画的图。

pairs.target: kàndào chuāng kǎn nà yíyè , tā xiān wèn yīnyǐng shìbushì shíwù .
pairs.english: At the sill drawing, she first asked whether the shading represented something solid.
pairs.hanzi: 看到窗槛那一页，她先问阴影是不是实物。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi lèng le yíxià , cái zhīdào zìjǐ miáo dé tàizhòng , zhǐzhe zhǐ shuō nàlǐ shì kōng de , hòutou zhī huà dé jiàn yì jiéduàn zuò .
pairs.english: Tavi paused before realizing he had drawn too darkly; pointing to the paper, he said that space was empty, with only one broken support visible behind it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维愣了一下，才知道自己描得太重，指着纸说那里是空的，后头只画得见一截断座。

pairs.target: " nà zhè tiáo biān ne ? "
pairs.english: “And this edge?”
pairs.hanzi: “那这条边呢？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi qù zhǎo yuángǎo , yù hé yǐjīng jiāng wèi miáo de nà zhāng dìguòlái .
pairs.english: Tavi went to find the original, but Yuhe was already handing over the untraced sheet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维去找原稿，郁禾已经将未描的那张递过来。

pairs.target: liǎngzhāng dié zhe kàn , níng qí cái diǎntóu , jiāng kànbùqīng de dìfāng gè quān le yìdiǎn , shuō shàngqù zài bǔ , búyòng zhěngzhāng zhònghuà .
pairs.english: Viewing both together, Ningqi nodded and circled the unclear areas, saying they could fill them in upstairs without redrawing everything.
pairs.hanzi: 两张叠着看，宁岐才点头，将看不清的地方各圈了一点，说上去再补，不用整张重画。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gāng sōng yìkǒuqì , tā yòu fān dào jiēkǒu , shuō zhè chē huà dé búcuò , yìyǎn biàn zhīdào zhuǎn bú guòqù .
pairs.english: Tavi had just relaxed when she turned to the junction and said the cart was well drawn: one glance showed it could not turn.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维刚松一口气，她又翻到街口，说这车画得不错，一眼便知道转不过去。

pairs.target: xiàwǔ yǔ tíng , tāmen dào jiù hú páng de shítī .
pairs.english: The rain stopped that afternoon, and they went to the stone stair beside the old arch.
pairs.hanzi: 下午雨停，他们到旧弧旁的石梯。

pairs.target: ā xún dài zhe dēng hé xìshéng , shū yàn xiān gēn shǒu lù de rén shuō guò , réng zhǐxǔ jìn hòu xíng wū , ménwài de fēng lán shuí yě bú dòng .
pairs.english: Axun brought a lamp and thin cord. Shuyan had checked with the keeper: they could still enter only the waiting house, and nobody would move the closed barrier beyond it.
pairs.hanzi: 阿荀带着灯和细绳，舒砚先跟守路的人说过，仍只许进候行屋，门外的封栏谁也不动。

pairs.target: níng qí zhàn zài ménkǒu kàn le bàntiān , zhǐzhe dìshàng jǐtiáo xìxìde shuǐ hén , wèn zuórì xiàyǔ qián xízi fàngzài nǎér .
pairs.english: Ningqi watched from the doorway for a while, pointed to thin water trails on the floor, and asked where the mats had been before yesterday's rain.
pairs.hanzi: 宁岐站在门口看了半天，指着地上几条细细的水痕，问昨日下雨前席子放在哪儿。

pairs.target: shū yàn dài tā kàn qiángbiān de shī yìn . tā méi jí zhe xiàng chuāngwài qù , xiān jiào ā xún jiàng ménpáng sōngdòng de jiù dèng bǎn bānkāi , lùchū xiàmiàn yìtiáo qiǎngōu .
pairs.english: Shuyan showed her the damp marks by the wall. Instead of heading outside the window, she had Axun move a loose old bench plank beside the door, revealing a shallow channel below.
pairs.hanzi: 舒砚带她看墙边的湿印。她没急着向窗外去，先叫阿荀将门旁松动的旧凳板搬开，露出下面一条浅沟。

pairs.target: gōukǒu sāi zhe gān yìng de huī hé zhúsī , shuǐ cóng pángbiān yìchū qù , yánzhe shífèng wǎng xià shèn .
pairs.english: Hard dry dust and bamboo fibers blocked the channel mouth, so water overflowed beside it and seeped down the stone joints.
pairs.hanzi: 沟口塞着干硬的灰和竹丝，水从旁边溢出去，沿着石缝往下渗。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dūnxià , jiāng juànzhǐ shōu dé yuǎn xiē , gēnzhe kàn nà dào gōu .
pairs.english: Tavi crouched, moved his rolled paper farther away, and looked at the channel too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维蹲下，将卷纸收得远些，跟着看那道沟。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ xià tóu pù ménqián yě yǒu yìtiáo xiécáo , yuánxiān yǐwéi zhǐshì sǎo shuǐ fāngbiàn .
pairs.english: He remembered a sloping groove by the shop door below, which he had thought merely made sweeping water easier.
pairs.hanzi: 他想起下头铺门前也有一条斜槽，原先以为只是扫水方便。

pairs.target: liǎngtiáo cáo gé dé yuǎn , xíngzhuàng què hěn xiàng , nèicè dōu liú zhe yìtiáo zhǎizhǎide píng biān .
pairs.english: The two grooves were far apart but similarly shaped, each with a narrow flat edge inside.
pairs.hanzi: 两条槽隔得远，形状却很像，内侧都留着一条窄窄的平边。

pairs.target: tā fān dào zìjǐ de tú , zhǐ gěi yù hé kàn , yòu pà huà cuò , xiān shuō le xià tóu nà chù méi liáng shēnqiǎn .
pairs.english: He turned to his drawing and showed Yuhe, first admitting, for fear of a mistake, that he had not measured the depth below.
pairs.hanzi: 他翻到自己的图，指给郁禾看，又怕画错，先说了下头那处没量深浅。

pairs.target: níng qí tīngjiàn , zǒuguò láikàn , suíjí jiào ā xún bié wǎng gōulǐ guànshuǐ . xiàmiàn zhù zhe rén , xiān zhǎo qīng chūkǒu , jīnrì bú zuò tōngshuǐ shìyàn .
pairs.english: Ningqi heard and came over, then told Axun not to pour water into the channel. People lived below; they needed the outlet located first, no water-flow test today.
pairs.hanzi: 宁岐听见，走过来看，随即叫阿荀别往沟里灌水。下面住着人，先找清出口，今日不做通水试验。

pairs.target: tā duì tǎ wéi shuō nà chù zhídé bǔ liáng , yòu wèn tā , chúle xiàngbuxiàng , jì bu jìde cháo nǎgè fāngxiàng .
pairs.english: She told Tavi that spot deserved further measurement, then asked if he remembered its direction as well as its likeness.
pairs.hanzi: 她对塔维说那处值得补量，又问他，除了像不像，记不记得朝哪个方向。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng le yíhuìer , zhǐxiàng xiàpō ; níng qí zhuǎnguò tú tǒng , ràng tā zài kàn yìyǎn chuāngzǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi thought a moment and pointed downhill; Ningqi turned the drawing tube and had him look at the window again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想了一会儿，指向下坡；宁岐转过图筒，让他再看一眼窗子。

pairs.target: yuánlái tā jiāng zìjǐ zhàn zhe de fāngxiàng dàngchéng le zhǐ de cháoxiàng , shǒuzhǐ chàdiǎn luòdào lìngyìtóu . tā jiāng zhěnggè rén zhuǎnguò lái , chóngxīn zhǐ , yù hé zài tú biān jiā le yìzhī jiàntóu .
pairs.english: He had mistaken his own orientation for the paper's and almost pointed the other way. He turned his whole body and pointed again, while Yuhe added an arrow at the drawing's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 原来他将自己站着的方向当成了纸的朝向，手指差点落到另一头。他将整个人转过来，重新指，郁禾在图边加了一支箭头。

pairs.target: ā xún zài wūlǐ fàng hǎo yìzhī xiǎo mùjià , níng qí dǎkāi cháng xiāng , qǔchū liǎnggēn duǎn tiě jiàn .
pairs.english: Axun set up a small wooden stand inside; Ningqi opened the long case and took out two short iron pieces.
pairs.hanzi: 阿荀在屋里放好一只小木架，宁岐打开长箱，取出两根短铁件。

pairs.target: tā xiān liáng zhīdiǎn hé qīngzǎi xià de yuánlái dúshù , jiào ā xún yíkāi xiùkǒu , cái shuāngshǒu fēnbié ànzhù tiě jiàn .
pairs.english: She first measured the supports and baseline readings under light loads, told Axun to move his cuff, then pressed one iron piece with each hand.
pairs.hanzi: 她先量支点和轻载下的原来读数，叫阿荀移开袖口，才双手分别按住铁件。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn xì zhēn cháo xiāngfǎn fāngxiàng huǎnhuǎn zǒu le yìdiǎn , níng qí réng chù zhe liǎngjiàn , piànkè biàn jiěkāi , xiè zàizhòng cè .
pairs.english: Tavi saw the fine needles move slightly in opposite directions. Ningqi kept touching both pieces, canceled after a moment, then unloaded and measured again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见细针朝相反方向缓缓走了一点，宁岐仍触着两件，片刻便解开，卸载重测。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu mō jiù hú , yě méiyǒu ràng nà jǐ jiéduàn zuò hūrán biànruǎn .
pairs.english: She had not touched the old arch or suddenly softened the broken supports.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有摸旧弧，也没有让那几截断座忽然变软。

pairs.target: xiāng lǐ de tiě jiàn hé jiàzi shì tā dàilái de jiàoyàn qì , xiān kàn zài zhèlǐ bǎi dé wěn bu wěn .
pairs.english: The iron pieces and stand were her own calibration apparatus, first checked for stability here.
pairs.hanzi: 箱里的铁件和架子是她带来的校验器，先看在这里摆得稳不稳。

pairs.target: liǎngbiān dúshù huídào yuánchù hòu , tā jiāng jià jiǎoxià de yìdiǎn shā bō diào , jiào ā xún zài bǎizhèng , jīnrì bù jí zhe zuò dìèrhuí .
pairs.english: After both readings returned to baseline, she brushed sand from beneath a stand foot, told Axun to align it again, and left a second trial for another day.
pairs.hanzi: 两边读数回到原处后，她将架脚下的一点砂拨掉，叫阿荀再摆正，今日不急着做第二回。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe nà liǎnggēn tiě jiàn bèi shōu hǎo , xīnlǐ yǒuxiē shuōbùchū de yíhàn , yòu bù zhīdào zìjǐ yuánlái děng zhe kàn shénme .
pairs.english: Watching the two iron pieces packed away, Tavi felt an inexpressible disappointment, unsure what he had expected to see.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着那两根铁件被收好，心里有些说不出的遗憾，又不知道自己原来等着看什么。

pairs.target: níng qí què yǐ zǒu dào tā zǎoxiān fāxiàn de kèhén qián , shēnshǒu yán pángbiān shí miàn bǐ le yíxià , méiyǒu pèng kèhén .
pairs.english: Ningqi had already reached the marks he had found earlier, comparing along the stone beside them with her hand without touching the incisions.
pairs.hanzi: 宁岐却已走到他早先发现的刻痕前，伸手沿旁边石面比了一下，没有碰刻痕。

pairs.target: " jiù tú gāi zhǎodào le ba ? " tā wèn shū yàn .
pairs.english: “The old plans have been found, I hope?” she asked Shuyan.
pairs.hanzi: “旧图该找到了吧？”她问舒砚。

pairs.target: " rén zhǎodào le , tú hái zài bān . " shū yàn shuō , " bié cuī , tā jīntiān zǒngsuàn huíqù shōu xízi le . "
pairs.english: “The man has, and the plans are being moved,” Shuyan said. “Don't hurry him. Today he finally went back to collect his mats.”
pairs.hanzi: “人找到了，图还在搬。”舒砚说，“别催，他今天总算回去收席子了。”

pairs.target: níng qí xiào zhe dūnxiàlái , jiào tǎ wéi bǎ nà zhāng méiyǒu xiěchéng shuǐxiàn de tú nágěi tā .
pairs.english: Ningqi crouched smiling and asked Tavi for the drawing he had not labeled waterlines.
pairs.hanzi: 宁岐笑着蹲下来，叫塔维把那张没有写成水线的图拿给她。

pairs.target: tā bǎ dēng nuó dī , guāng luò jìnqù , kèhén páng yígè yuánlái kànbùqīng de zì , zhōngyú cóng mópíng de shí miànshàng xiǎn chūlái yíbàn .
pairs.english: She lowered the lamp; as the light fell, half a previously unreadable character beside the marks finally emerged from the worn stone.
pairs.hanzi: 她把灯挪低，光落进去，刻痕旁一个原来看不清的字，终于从磨平的石面上显出来一半。
